fields.why: The disparity is framed, but the article's own race-specific rates are only set side by side (cap at 2); the only ratio ('at least 10 times higher') is cited from an earlier report. A rule that quantification must be computed from the article's own data would decide it.

brief_issues: Level 3 'quantified' does not say whether a contrast cited from prior work counts; data_focus already treats cited figures as limited, suggesting it should not.
